cases.title: "I know one end" ON, upstream 19.45, Set my own 1 in 100 on a 4.1 m pit-to-pit pipe: no Grade mismatch window, IL texts 19.45 and 19.40
cases.plan_item: B-057b Grade mismatch window skips CE's own suggested level (PR
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Written 30 Oct 2026 from the Opus re-check H2 (robot case 1) and the code at 7c6af57b; not compared with a run.
cases.expected: Two pits at 150000,-70000 and 154550,-70000; CD pit to pit, 100 mm, text off, Set my own 100, "I know one end" ON (upstream known), known level 19.45, Start Pipe: no "Grade mismatch" window opens, exactly one new CE pipe, IL texts reading 19.45 and 19.40 (2 or 3 decimals). A reset pipe follows and is recorded. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The unit tests call the check function with box values; only the live CD Draw path works the level out again from "I know one end" and decides whether the window opens.
not_automated: The pipe label grade (1 IN 100) is not read: a 4.1 m pipe puts its label on a leader that needs two mouse clicks, so main pipe text is switched off.
The look of the drawn pipe and its IL texts is not judged (no window to look at in this letter).
